HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.
   B. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   D. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)

   A. Nairobi
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)

   B. Hide all money underground
